reason: B proposes a concrete, measurable microstructural intervention directly supported by prior EHEA evidence and tests ductility, strength, dislocation accumulation, and phase-selective recrystallization against an untreated control. Its main weakness is that recrystallization generally requires stored deformation energy, so the annealing protocol may need a defined pre-strain, whereas A leaves the dopant, concentration, segregation behavior, and interface mechanism too unspecified and unsupported.
